purpose: Replace visibly arranged social figures with natural circulation and make every Cat placement a physically plausible Perch at a deliberate foreground, midground, or distant framing.

ambientLifePolicy.purpose: People and traffic communicate ordinary use of the real place rather than filling empty space.
required: Arrange people asymmetrically across the real circulation surface.
Mix loose pairs or small groups with isolated individuals where the location plausibly supports them.
Vary depth, apparent scale, direction of travel, lateral position, spacing, and simple body gesture.
Allow mild natural overlap between distant people while keeping faces non-identifiable.
Keep all people and vehicles outside the Cat Perch safeBounds.
Keep the landmark and route legible; Ambient Life remains secondary.
forbidden: single-file procession unless the real path physically forces it
same-size figures on one depth plane
people placed only along an image edge
readable clothing marks, signage, plates, route text, advertisements, logos, or livery

catPlacementPolicy.anchorSemantics: bottom-center of the Portrait asset; x and y may be anywhere in the Scene
catPlacementPolicy.purpose: The Cat remains the narrative traveler but may be visually primary, supporting, or a small distant cameo.
perchRequirements: Record framing, narrativeWeight, depthBand, physicalSupport, accessPlausibility, poseFit, and clearSilhouette in placementIntent.
The Portrait feet or body base must meet a visible support plane with believable perspective.
The Perch must be reachable in the physical world and appropriate for the selected pose.
Do not use an unsafe cliff lip, protected ruin wall, traffic lane, water surface, roof with no plausible access, or floating visual gap.
Keep the complete Portrait silhouette inside the image and outside people, vehicles, rails, posts, furniture, and hard shadows.
Current compositing has no foreground occlusion mask, so the Perch must not require the Cat to appear behind an object.
At distant framing, preserve local contrast behind the Cat without creating a spotlight, empty box, outline, or artificial clearing.

globalExclusions: player cat or substitute cat drawn into the scene candidate
readable text, pseudo-text, dates, postmarks, logos, watermarks, UI, frames, guides, anchors, or safe-bound marks in the scene candidate
photorealism, 3D rendering, flat vector art, neon-heavy lighting, thick black outlines, hard gradients, malformed landmarks
physically unsupported Portrait placement, incorrect perspective scale, hidden feet without an occlusion mask, staged crowd, evenly spaced people
